hook: Paramount, Legendary, and Capcom's Street Fighter claimed the No. 1 spot at the October box office.

sections.voiceover: Paramount, Legendary, and Capcom's Street Fighter claimed the No. 1 spot at the October box office.
b_roll: Cinematic title display of Street Fighter

sections.voiceover: Paramount, Legendary, and Capcom released Street Fighter to 3,575 North American theaters. Friday ticket sales alone reached $13 million. Where did the total opening gross land?
Twentieth Century Studio's Whalefall couldn't keep up, but worse, it tanked hard.
Street Fighter achieved a massive $31 million opening weekend.
b_roll: Bar chart comparing box office figures

sections.voiceover: Twentieth Century Studio's Whalefall pulled in just $7.5 million against a $60 million budget.
